Policy development within the provided corpus is documented through a single, specific planned update regarding ADHD treatment metrics. The performance metric known as [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] is expected to undergo improvements. This anticipated policy development is directly driven by upcoming guidance from the [[danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger|Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer)]], specifically their forthcoming guidelines concerning the non-pharmacological treatment of ADHD [^src1]. Because the available evidence is limited to this single assertion, no further details regarding broader policy development, timelines, or additional stakeholders are currently available in the corpus.

## Claims

- Indikator 5 vil blive forbedret i lyset af den kommende DMPG-retningslinje om nonfarmakologisk behandling af ADHD [^src1] (indikator-5, danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger)
